flags.message: Staged record/documents/brief-in-opposition.txt combines respondent Irigoyen Farms's pre-cutoff Aug. 26, 2026 brief with co-respondent Walmart Inc.'s post-cutoff Oct. 13, 2026 response (which was the response requested on Sept. 10, 2026), because documents_before dates a combined opposition row by its earliest brief (docs/document-provisioning.md). Although this is a forward-mode cell, the forecast is reasoned from the pre-cutoff 2026-09-11 record without relying on Walmart's Oct. 13 brief.
